stem: Based on the information in the selection “Tradition with a Twist,” what can the reader conclude about Sedjro Ahouansou and Valerie Vinakpon?

options.label: A
options.text: They live near each other in the same country.

options.label: B
options.text: They use many flavors to make desserts.

options.label: C
options.text: They are interested in more than just how their food tastes.

options.label: D
options.text: They hear praise about their dishes from different parts of the world.
